canonical_statement: Over binary strings, verifier-based NP equals the class recognized by polynomial-time nonadaptive oracle checkers using O(log n) random bits, O(1) proof queries, perfect completeness, and soundness one half.
domain_and_universes: Word := List Bool; Language := Word -> Prop; proof oracles are Nat -> Bool; all definitions inhabit universe 0.
conclusion: Set equality {language | InNP language} = {language | InPCPLogConst language}; a checked extensional transport gives the corresponding universally quantified iff.

encoding_policy.alphabet: Bool for inputs, NP certificates, verifier randomness, proof answers, and oracle values
encoding_policy.machine_model: Turing.FinTM2 witnesses polynomial time for resource, query, decision, and NP verifier functions
encoding_policy.oracle_model: infinite binary proof Nat -> Bool with nonadaptive positions computed solely from input and randomness
encoding_policy.randomness: exactly randomLength input bits, eventually bounded by randomConstant * Nat.log2 (input.length + 1)
encoding_policy.queries: a uniform constant bound on the length of every well-sized query list
encoding_policy.completeness: perfect completeness for every random string
encoding_policy.soundness: at most one half of all uniformly enumerated random strings accept

killed: replaced equality by the NP-to-PCP inclusion
weakened logarithmic randomness to a polynomial bound

degenerate_cases: Empty inputs, zero-length randomness, empty query lists, repeated queries, and small inputs below the eventual logarithmic threshold remain admitted. A zero-query checker still must meet completeness and soundness. Malformed randomness is excluded from acceptance by the Fin-indexed interface.
alternate_encodings: No transport is claimed for adaptive queries, nonbinary alphabets, bounded-error completeness, other soundness constants, finite proof strings, or alternative randomized machine and cost models.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory plus mathlib finite sets and Turing-machine definitions; the statement declares no axiom.
tcb_profile: Lean kernel, pinned Lean toolchain, pinned mathlib source, and the existing Lake environment.
computation_profile: No native evaluation or probabilistic oracle is credited. Probability one half is represented exactly by finite cardinalities.
status_boundary: This freezes and elaborates one exact standard PCP-theorem formulation. It supplies no PCP proof, source H0 review, anchor audit, or downstream completion evidence.
